name: Crystal International Group Limited
summary: Crystal International Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and trading of garments in the Asia Pacific, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers lifestyle wear, denim, intimate, sweater, and sportswear and outdoor apparel products. It also provides value-added services, including printing, washing, and embroidery. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Kowloon City, Hong Kong.
